notes.title: Atmosphere
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45318822/8b3781a95b50e78aa3a20ac89bd70701cd227df3.png[/img]

[b][Quality][/b]  
- With the creation of new tools to enhance the project's atmosphere, we updated the fog system and part of the project's lighting.
- The sound quality has been completely reworked, now being physically more realistic for each type of environment.

[b][Optimization][/b]  
- The new fog system is potentially more optimized, replacing the old system.  
- We improved the project's performance while maintaining the game's graphical quality.

[b][Bugs][/b]  
- We fixed some interaction bugs.  
- We removed some interactive items that were causing artifacts.

notes.title: Quality Improvement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45318822/bb9118d716e8bd65a6bcb4316224ee43ad7c1fb9.png[/img]

Over the months, we have been adjusting the demo to ensure an immersive gameplay experience without interruptions caused by technical issues. This update aims to:

- Improve the overall quality of the ocean.

- Adjust some cinematics.

- Enhance performance on computers.

- Fix certain artifacts that occurred when the save system was triggered.

All of this is being developed alongside the final version. Every improvement implemented in the project as a whole will be added to the demo version.

notes.title: Stable version
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45318822/63861b8921429660a20372c141cd332a36edc496.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45318822/e5189c774d9f40a3a7f54a15cdb6118b5f3015ff.png[/img][/url]

The narrative has always been the strong point of The Secrets of the Lighthouse. Some aspects affected the quality of the final product, but most of them have been fixed, making this the most stable version to date, including:

- Adjustment to the inspection camera.
- Fixes for some map-related bugs.
- Tweaks to certain animations and cinematics.
- Improvements to some game interfaces.
- Fix for door mechanics, where a bug previously prevented the door state from being saved when respawning or loading a previous save.
- Loading adjustments to fix a bug that caused the screen to go black when opening the game for the first time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45318822/67dc2f4ae602399733c495e041adc81f64fe6867.png[/img]

notes.title: Optimization
notes.content:
[h1][b][Optimization][/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45318822/63861b8921429660a20372c141cd332a36edc496.png[/img]

* All vegetation on the island was reviewed and replaced aiming for better hardware performance as a whole.

* Removed some assets that caused a drastic loss of FPS.

[list]
[*] [h2]Known bugs/artifacts[/h2]
[/list]

* We know there are open areas that give the impression of being walkable, this will be fixed in a future update.

* Some areas still need more vegetation, we will add it little by little according to user feedback.

[list]
[*] [h2]Final notes[/h2]
[/list]

* The graphical quality of the project was not compromised, just revised and replaced with something that works better on all devices.

notes.title: Otimização e Funcionalidade
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45318822/2bd9521c7a3989412c5a8018ebb418d263a7c60d.png[/img]

- Added some assets for a better history context.

[Game]

- Created an option to change the [b]subtitle size[[/b] in "Game" section.

notes.title: Subtitles and Level Design
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45318822/50457870a9444564576a38c6c871c64113ca3407.png[/img]

[b]Beta v0.21.02[/b]

- Adjustments to the collectable objects for a better visualization.

- Adjustments to the subtitles without translation to English. 


[b][Bug Fixes][/b]

- Sound returning to default when the player get a picture.
- Frame Generation returning to "[b]Normal[/b]" when selecting "[b]DLSS[/b]" or "[b]XeSS[/b]".

[b][Known Issues][/b]

- VRAM crash during loading: This issue will be fixed in the next updates with a more efficient loading system.

- White bottom border between loadings: This bug will be fixed in the next updates, but is currently necessary to avoid some crashes.
